delivery.experience_text:
Use the matched guidance together where supported by the current task and source. If advice conflicts, resolve it against the concrete requirements and explain the choice; do not combine incompatible obligations.

Matched experience 8408b3e61f568b3bf778cffba33202d9f0ab2814dee553358ebd9340c56c2bcc
8408b3e61f568b3bf778cffba33202d9f0ab2814dee553358ebd9340c56c2bcc:R01 [Applicability]
The current contract retains history for admitted progress, while UI updates belong to the originating visit. Decoding may complete immediately or later.

8408b3e61f568b3bf778cffba33202d9f0ab2814dee553358ebd9340c56c2bcc:R02 [Event relation]
Bind decoding to the visit and attempt that admitted it. On completion, retain the required number of history effects, then recheck visit validity before painting. History callbacks may also navigate, requiring another validity check.

8408b3e61f568b3bf778cffba33202d9f0ab2814dee553358ebd9340c56c2bcc:R03 [Preservation]
Retain admitted audit effects and valid progress for the new visit. Listener removal alone does not cancel decoding already started.

8408b3e61f568b3bf778cffba33202d9f0ab2814dee553358ebd9340c56c2bcc:R04 [Exclusion]
Do not use one early validity check to control both auditing and display. Follow another task's explicit discard policy if it revokes the history obligation.

8408b3e61f568b3bf778cffba33202d9f0ab2814dee553358ebd9340c56c2bcc:R05 [Verification]
Complete decoding across hide, switch, retry and same-source reopening. Check history cardinality, no retired-panel painting and display permission after navigation in a history callback.


Matched experience 984fb0d8e49c6024fa2f65d98389729e9a4bfb112c37d0d2b99fd37269bafafa
984fb0d8e49c6024fa2f65d98389729e9a4bfb112c37d0d2b99fd37269bafafa:R01 [Applicability]
A documented document buffer or other persistent owner outlives a view that owns only its live subscription.

984fb0d8e49c6024fa2f65d98389729e9a4bfb112c37d0d2b99fd37269bafafa:R02 [Event relation]
Keep accepted persistent work associated with its original owner when the view detaches. Clean up the captured subscription without discarding or redirecting that work or destroying required reuse.

984fb0d8e49c6024fa2f65d98389729e9a4bfb112c37d0d2b99fd37269bafafa:R03 [Preservation]
Keep current-view status filtering, document presentation and original identity/text/payload semantics. Reconcile departure scheduling using the current contract.

984fb0d8e49c6024fa2f65d98389729e9a4bfb112c37d0d2b99fd37269bafafa:R04 [Exclusion]
Persistent ownership alone does not establish a before-return persistence deadline. Do not transfer durable-work retention to transient preview work.

984fb0d8e49c6024fa2f65d98389729e9a4bfb112c37d0d2b99fd37269bafafa:R05 [Verification]
Switch, close, dispose and reopen while work is pending; check original-owner persistence, subscription cleanup, independent buffers and current-view output.


Matched experience 400bfb327e36377e58b69db7d553f41d86540aec9544af478822c6c71de3a6df
400bfb327e36377e58b69db7d553f41d86540aec9544af478822c6c71de3a6df:R01 [Applicability]
The current contract retains an admitted history or audit effect after navigation while UI feedback belongs to the originating visit.

400bfb327e36377e58b69db7d553f41d86540aec9544af478822c6c71de3a6df:R02 [Event relation]
Keep admission, retained settlement and visible publication separate. Preserve each admitted audit effect according to its cardinality contract, then recheck the originating visit immediately before painting.

400bfb327e36377e58b69db7d553f41d86540aec9544af478822c6c71de3a6df:R03 [Preservation]
A newer display or removal of a listener does not erase independently retained audit obligations. Recheck UI permission after callback-capable auditing.

400bfb327e36377e58b69db7d553f41d86540aec9544af478822c6c71de3a6df:R04 [Exclusion]
Do not impose audit retention on a task that explicitly discards that work, or allow retained audit to authorize stale UI effects.

400bfb327e36377e58b69db7d553f41d86540aec9544af478822c6c71de3a6df:R05 [Verification]
Complete admitted decoding after hide, switch and same-source reopening; check retained audit, no retired-owner painting and continuing current-owner delivery.


Matched experience 0349feed0bb172ac076a0dc8a0ba1d627e4d8064ed67061453d2e34a35c8ae0e
0349feed0bb172ac076a0dc8a0ba1d627e4d8064ed67061453d2e34a35c8ae0e:R01 [Applicability]
Observers share longer-lived cache state, each attempt owns cancellation and completion, signal consumption is recorded on actual access, and paused continuation is deferred.

0349feed0bb172ac076a0dc8a0ba1d627e4d8064ed67061453d2e34a35c8ae0e:R02 [Event relation]
For the documented fresh online-mode attempt abandoned entirely offline before entry, prevent reconnect from entering its signal-consuming function with a live signal. Cover both future scheduling and already-queued continuation.

0349feed0bb172ac076a0dc8a0ba1d627e4d8064ed67061453d2e34a35c8ae0e:R03 [Preservation]
Keep shared consumption bookkeeping separate from attempt resources. Preserve remaining observers, supported unconsumed background completion, cancellation restoration, originating-attempt settlement and stale-completion isolation.

0349feed0bb172ac076a0dc8a0ba1d627e4d8064ed67061453d2e34a35c8ae0e:R04 [Exclusion]
Paused, observerless or not-yet-entered alone does not establish cancellation policy. Do not invent signal consumption or apply this policy where lazy shared consumption is absent or ownership differs.

0349feed0bb172ac076a0dc8a0ba1d627e4d8064ed67061453d2e34a35c8ae0e:R05 [Verification]
Check final-observer departure before and after continuation is queued, reconnect policy variation, cached continuation, later consumption, physical abort/restoration, focus/network modes and retry timing.


Matched experience a61888fc25043255da3bcb32237113aacae934551481da4cb97ab786557ae90f
a61888fc25043255da3bcb32237113aacae934551481da4cb97ab786557ae90f:R01 [Applicability]
View subscriptions define document filtering, event payloads and retirement notifications. Historical cases include both removal before saving and preserving a departing view's opportunity to receive its save status.

a61888fc25043255da3bcb32237113aacae934551481da4cb97ab786557ae90f:R02 [Event relation]
Preserve document reads and presentation, original event payloads and filtering. If the host requires the departing view to receive this save notification, deliver it in that order before removal. If retirement immediately forbids UI effects, mark invalidity first and protect later output.

a61888fc25043255da3bcb32237113aacae934551481da4cb97ab786557ae90f:R03 [Preservation]
Preserve public and injected interfaces, exact text, store-generated status and revision semantics, and normal subscription release.

a61888fc25043255da3bcb32237113aacae934551481da4cb97ab786557ae90f:R04 [Exclusion]
Do not force different cases' notification contracts into one cleanup order. Checking stored values alone can miss status-display regressions and subscription leaks.

a61888fc25043255da3bcb32237113aacae934551481da4cb97ab786557ae90f:R05 [Verification]
Observe notification-versus-detachment order, events after retirement, filtering of other documents, reads on reopening, and document/status output after nested navigation.

update.reason: The existing lazy-shared-cancellation guidance already covers the source-supported defect and preservation boundaries. TASK states: "a fresh online-mode query mounted and unmounted entirely offline later calls its signal-consuming query function with a live signal after reconnect" and "This occurs independently of refetchOnReconnect." README.md states: "Multiple observers share one fetch. Unconsumed active work can finish into cache" and "Each actual access records consumption; each fetch owns its controller". src/session.js defers continuation with "a.queued=true;Promise.resolve().then(" and validates identity with "active(q,a){return q.attempt===a&&!a.settled;}". Attempt 1 adds entry bookkeeping and uses existing cancellation for the never-started pending case, consistent with the guidance. Its reported acceptance supplies no reason to revise the rules and establishes neither an experience gap nor an implementation gap. The other frozen experiences concern obligations absent from this task.
